edits.old: Then the audit log holds one approval for version 3
edits.new:
Then the audit log holds one approval for version 3

  Scenario: AC11 Approval needs Documents A (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given version 3 of "DEMAND-MTG" "TH" is in state "Draft" and "LIT-0101" does not hold Documents A
    When "LIT-0101" approves version 3
    Then the system refuses it with a status Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P6-E1034-APP-AC11)

  Scenario: AC12 Error answers 401, 403 and 404 of the provided operations (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a request to one of the five template operations carries no valid credential
    When the request is sent
    Then the system answers with status 401
    Then a request by a user without the operation's permission is answered with status 403
    Then a request for a template that does not exist is answered with status 404
